label: R5 · Your blocks
rationale: Ainok Tracker is a 3/3 first striker: a single 3/2 blocker dies before it deals damage, a pure loss. A double (or triple) block trades one 3/2 for the Tracker, since first-strike damage can kill only one blocker and the rest deal 3, safe with the opponent tapped out. Taking 3 at 20 life is also fine. The single block is the blunder.
